description: Dividers are used to visually separate or group elements.
title: Default

description: Use the --width custom property to change the width of the divider.
title: Width

description: Use the --color custom property to change the color of the divider.
title: Color

description: Use the --spacing custom property to change the amount of space between the divider and it’s neighboring elements.
title: Spacing

description: Add the vertical attribute to draw the divider in a vertical orientation. The divider will span the full height of its container. Vertical dividers work especially well inside of a flex container.
title: Vertical
